title: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion
definition: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion is God's freeing of believers from sin's ruling power through union with Christ.
summary: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion teaches that believers are freed from sin's ruling power through union with Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ died and rose so His people would no longer be enslaved to sin.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on sin's broken mastery over the believer. Though Christians still battle sin, they are no longer helpless slaves under its lordship. Christ's death and resurrection create a new realm where obedience becomes possible by grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many believers mistake temptation for ownership. The Gospel says sin remains an enemy, but it is not the believer's master. This gives hope for real change without pretending the battle is easy.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Name sin as a defeated tyrant, not your identity. Fight temptation from your union with Christ rather than from self-reliance. Use prayer, confession, Scripture, and fellowship as means of walking in new freedom.
